sentences.japanese: お前は一人で泳ぎに行くにはまだ幼すぎる。
sentences.english: You are not old enough to go swimming by yourself.

sentences.japanese: 学校は幼いものが社会生活に備える手助けをするために始められた。
sentences.english: Schools were started to help young people prepare for living in the world.

sentences.japanese: まだ幼い時に歌を始めました。
sentences.english: I began to sing when I was a youngster.

sentences.japanese: はい、私達は幼い頃からの友達です。
sentences.english: Yes, we have been friends since our childhood.

sentences.japanese: たった一人の幼い娘しか彼らにはいなかった。
sentences.english: Only one little daughter did they have.
